reserveReview.rationale: Authored from Figure Certificate Company's Q3 2026 Form 10-Q (accession 0001628280-26-073949, period end September 30, 2026, filed November 16, 2026 after EDGAR acceptance on November 13, 2026 at 17:57 ET). Schedule I (Reg S-X Rule 12-21, investment in securities of unaffiliated issuers as of September 30, 2026) reports nine U.S. Treasury bills totalling $452.170 million ($24.946m due 10/22/2026, $24.914m due 11/3/2026, $99.574m due 11/10/2026, $24.891m due 11/12/2026, $24.874m due 11/19/2026, $19.869m due 12/3/2026, $99.268m due 12/10/2026, $84.293m due 12/17/2026 and $49.541m due 12/24/2026; longest maturity 85 days) and $59.315 million of UMB Bank N.A. repurchase agreements collateralized by U.S. Treasury securities maturing 10/1/2026 (1 day), for $511.485 million of investments. Schedule V (Reg S-X Rule 12-27, qualified assets on deposit as of September 30, 2026) reports $0 cash and $511.491 million of investments in securities at UMB Bank N.A. (Schedule I's $511.485 million plus $6 thousand of accrued interest receivable per Footnote 1), $0.700 million of cash at Flagstar Bank, N.A., and $0.554 million of FCC-attributable cash at Lead Bank (held in an account of affiliate Figure Payments Corporation), for $1.254 million of cash, $512.739 million of cash and cash equivalents, and $512.745 million of total qualified assets against $505.013 million of certificate reserve liability ($505.3 million Section 28 Reserve Requirement including $250 thousand minimum capital stock). Normalized over the $512.739 million cash and cash equivalents denominator (Schedule I investments plus Schedule V cash, matching the FY2025 10-K treatment), weights are 88.1872%, 11.5683%, 0.1365% and 0.1080%. These Q3 2026 interim financial statements and schedules are unaudited and management-certified by FCC's CEO and CFO under SOX Sections 302 and 906 (Exhibits 31.1, 31.2, 32.1 and 32.2); they carry no independent auditor's opinion or review report. KPMG LLP's FY2025 Form 10-K audit opinion dated 2026-03-19 (covering the December 31, 2025 balance sheets and schedules of investments) remains the latest independent assurance.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Schedule V of the unaudited, management-certified Q3 2026 Form 10-Q names the depositaries holding qualified assets as of September 30, 2026: UMB Bank N.A. ($511.491 million including $6 thousand accrued interest receivable, or $511.485 million of Schedule I securities with $0 cash), Flagstar Bank, N.A. ($0.700 million cash) and Lead Bank ($0.554 million, the FCC-attributable portion of an account held by affiliate Figure Payments Corporation), totalling $512.745 million ($512.739 million excluding accrued interest). KPMG LLP's FY2025 Form 10-K audit as of December 31, 2025 remains the latest independent assurance. The certificates remain unsecured obligations of FCC and the filing does not establish statutory bankruptcy remoteness, so remoteness stays contractual-only. The filing does not state a general prohibition on reuse of the deposited collateral, so rehypothecation stays unknown.
